title: Generic Ingest Edge
description: An edge used in a generic graph ingestion system. Each edge has a `kind` describing the relationship, and `start`/`end` node-match criteria that resolve the endpoints. Edges may also include a `properties` object containing custom attributes.

property_map.description: A key-value map of entity attributes. Values must not be objects. If a value is an array, it must contain only primitive types (e.g., strings, numbers, booleans) and must be homogeneous (all items must be of the same type).

node_match_criteria.description: Criteria for resolving an edge endpoint to a node. `value` holds the identifier; `match_by` selects whether it is matched against a node's `id` or `name`.

kind.description: The relationship type. Should match the pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$ so it survives BloodHound's kind post-processing.
